title.zh-CN: 磨砂亚克力板透明素材

prompt_cases.author: Dheepanratnam
prompt_cases.prompt_text: PNG asset of a hand holding a clear acrylic sheet with a subtle frosted edge, photographed straight on. The acrylic sheet must have realistic partial transparency, visible refraction and a soft translucent gradient, while the hand and fingers remain fully opaque. Native alpha channel, clean anti-aliased edges, no background, no colour contamination, no harsh cut-out edges. Premium UI/design asset, centred composition.

title.zh-CN: 铬金属流体丝带透明素材

prompt_cases.author: Dheepanratnam
prompt_cases.prompt_text: Transparent PNG asset of a floating 3D chrome ribbon logo shape, elegantly twisted like liquid metal, with realistic specular highlights and soft internal reflections. Fully transparent background, native alpha channel, crisp edges around every curve, no background glow, no rectangular bounding artefacts, no drop shadow baked in. Minimal premium brand asset, centred, suitable for overlaying on video or web design.

notes: Only public X post photo attachments and source-attributed full prompts. Some posts are multi-model comparisons. Third-party media rights reserved.
